items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Monk’s – it was really a challenge. He used to say, he says, “Drummers can only play at three tempos.”

ctx.x: Monk’s – it was really a challenge. He used to say, he says, “Drummers can only play at three tempos.” He know that his … was odd tempos and odd – sometime you didn’t know what to – you had to make something to play on it.
Was he like all the other great leaders you worked for, just let you do what you want to do? Or did he suggest anything?
